user_authorization: Prevent replacing original numbers with different numbers to make results look better.
controls: JRA-live ticket ev_current is recomputed from canonical hit_prob and current odds.
JRA-live formation EV is recomputed from every point's hit probability and current odds.
Reviewer fails closed on missing, non-finite, or inconsistent probability, odds, EV, and portfolio summary values.
Portfolio expected return uses canonical JRA-live arithmetic instead of reported EV fields.
Evaluation input, result labels, baseline, evaluator, leakage guard, integrity guard, experiment runner, constitution, and parameters are SHA-256 pinned.
Baseline and candidate evaluation both require available, non-empty result labels.
Candidate metrics must exactly match evaluator stdout before baseline promotion.
Baseline promotion uses atomic replacement and is impossible after an integrity mismatch.
decision_reason: Explicitly requested fail-closed safety control. This is not an ROI or performance improvement and makes no performance claim.
